_comment: Endpoints to probe. Ports come from vendor docs where published. Multi-port entries exist because a port-22-only sweep records an entire class of host as dead - the Blinkenshell FAQ states port 2222 explicitly, and peli-cloud recorded that dialling it on 22/2222/443 all returned 0 bytes from a sandbox that refuses 22 anyway.

expected_failures.ssh.alwaysdata.com: Per-account host: alwaysdata gives every account its own hostname, so a public name will not resolve or will not be the user's shell. Listed deliberately so the run proves that rather than asserting it.
expected_failures.blinkenshell.org:22: Control. The vendor states 2222. If 2222 answers and 22 does not, that is the port-2222 finding reproduced from a residential host.
